example.heic is the public libheif example, downloaded from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/strukturag/libheif/master/examples/example.heic
on 2026-11-11. Source/license: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif (LGPL).
It is a decoder regression fixture, not an authenticated iPhone camera sample.

high-resolution.heic is a synthetic solid-color 6000×8000 (48 MP) portrait,
generated with Sharp and encoded with macOS sips. No personal/camera content.
